identity.name: Submariner Date
identity.one_liner: The two-tone Submariner Date — Oystersteel and 18k yellow gold, black dial, black Cerachrom bezel. The accessible-luxury Submariner and the most-cited Rolex two-tone.

narrative.story: The 126613LN replaced the 116613LN in 2020 with the 41mm case and the calibre 3235. The two-tone Submariner is the Rolex that opens the Submariner line to buyers who cannot justify the $10,900 all-steel (because of the AD waitlist) and who do not want an all-gold Rolex that reads as a status statement. The 126613LN holds its value well; the all-gold 116618LB (blue dial) and 116618 (black) and 116619LB (blue dial) round out the gold Submariner family.
